title: Sales Consultant
description:
Tipo de contrato: Tempo determinado

Descrição:
Cargo Sales Consultant Indústria Número de vagas 1 Descrição da função Conduct market research and collect relevant data on Angola’s agricultural certification sector; Identify and develop a database of potential farms, exporters, cooperatives, and agribusiness clients; Assess market opportunities for AFRICERT certification services; Identify potential partnerships and business development opportunities; Analyze competitors and existing certification service providers; Evaluate market challenges, risks, and operational requirements; Support initial engagement with potential clients and stakeholders; Provide recommendations on AFRICERT’s market entry approach.

Requisitos:
Titulação mínima Licenciatura Experiência exigida 5 Anos Nacionalidade Não definido Línguas Português, Inglês Area funcional Competências Gestão de projectos Aptidões necessárias Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Agricultural Economics, Environmental Science, or a related field; Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in agricultural consultancy, certification, sustainability, agribusiness development, or related fields; Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of agricultural certification standards, audit processes, compliance requirements, and sustainability practices; Experience working with farmers, exporters, cooperatives, agribusiness organizations, or agricultural value chain stakeholders; Experience in conducting market assessments, feasibility studies, stakeholder mapping, or business development assignments; Good understanding of the Angolan agricultural sector and local market dynamics; Ability to collect, analyze, and present market information through professional reports; Strong communication, networking, and stakeholder engagement skills; Fluency in English and Portuguese
